descriptions.zh:
先获取主播流域名，再调用本接口查询播流域名下的直播封装配置。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为300次/分钟。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
Obtain the primary streaming domain first, and then call this operation to query the live packaging configuration under the streaming domain.

## QPS limit
The single-user QPS limit for this operation is 300 calls per minute. If the limit is exceeded, API calls will be throttled, which may affect your business. Please call this operation as appropriate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-package-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name AppName --stream-name StreamName --page-num 1 --page-size 10 --order asc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLivePackageConfig --region cn-hangzhou --Order asc --StreamName StreamName --PageNum 1 --PageSize 10 --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName AppName
